```yaml
name: Community Tests (No Secrets)

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "dev" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  code_quality:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pyproject.toml
            requirements*.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Validate lockfile
        run: |
          pip-compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe pyproject.toml
          pip-compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe requirements-dev.in

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1

      - name: Run ruff check
        run: |
          ruff check .

      - name: Run ruff format
        run: |
          ruff format --check .

  unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pyproject.toml
            requirements*.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest \
            tests/unit/graph/ \
            tests/unit/processing/ \
            tests/unit/chunking/ \
            tests/unit/retrieval/ \
            tests/unit/search/ \
            tests/unit/pipelines/ \
            tests/unit/visualization/ \
            tests/unit/ontology/ \
            tests/unit/permissions/ \
            tests/unit/cache/ \
            tests/unit/session/ \
            tests/unit/config/ \
            tests/unit/eval_framework/ \
            -xvs

  cli_unit_tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pyproject.toml
            requirements*.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Run CLI unit tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest \
            tests/unit/cli/test_*.py \
            -xvs

  telemetry_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: code_quality
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            pyproject.toml
            requirements*.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          pip install -r requirements-dev.txt

      - name: Run telemetry test
        run: |
          python -m pytest \
            tests/unit/telemetry/test_telemetry.py \
            -xvs

  finalize:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs:
      - code_quality
      - unit_tests
      - cli_unit_tests
      - telemetry_test
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Finalize
        run: |
          echo "All tests completed successfully."
```
